title: Inter-frequency handover · 5G SA
description: Investigate Meridian's mobility failure and compare it with the intra-frequency control and the Solstice CDUT. The times and events shown are the ones recorded in the field case.

controle-intra.label: Meridian · intra-frequency
controle-intra.title: Intra-frequency handover completed
controle-intra.description: Meridian · n78 PCI 88 → PCI 101 · same frequency · three repetitions

evidence.title: Stable intra-RAT control
evidence.html: 3/3 handovers complete; the Report → completion chain took 155–160 ms.

evidence.title: No link failure
evidence.html: Record 0xB959 kept OOS_FILT_BLER below threshold in every repetition.

evidence.title: Detailed log not provided
evidence.html: The material includes full logs for scenarios 2 (DUT) and 3 (CDUT), not for this control.

controle-intra.notice: The case describes this scenario as a same-frequency control. No detailed log file is attached for it; the values shown come from the challenge sheet.
controle-intra.logLabel: No detailed log file for this scenario.

playbackSteps.summary: measId=1 (A3, hysteresis 1 dB, TTT 320 ms) and measId=3 (A2, −100 dBm, TTT 160 ms) active since the first RRCReconfiguration; n41 is not configured.
SS-RSRP/SS-RSRQ serving −101 dBm/−13 dB; neighbour PCI 101 −90 dBm/−8 dB.
reconfigurationWithSync without absoluteFrequencySSB (same frequency), rach-ConfigDedicated present, t304=2000 ms.
Handover complete 155 ms after the Report. Repetitions 02 and 03: 1.312 s and 1.370 s; OOS_FILT_BLER (0xB959) always below threshold.

dut-inter.label: Meridian · inter-frequency
dut-inter.title: Handover delay and Radio Link Failure
dut-inter.description: Meridian · n78 PCI 88 → n41 PCI 145/160 · three repetitions

evidence.title: Late inter-frequency measurement
evidence.html: measId=2 (A5, TTT 240 ms) reported only 3.660–3.730 s after configuration.

evidence.title: RLF before handover completion
evidence.html: t310-Expiry occurs at 3.830–3.870 s; no handover completes in this scenario.

evidence.title: Attempt on an unsuitable serving cell
evidence.html: PCI 88 is below q-RxLevMin; six Msg1 fail before the attempt on PCI 145.

evidence.title: Recovery on the neighbour cell
evidence.html: On PCI 145, RRCReestablishmentRequest and Complete are recorded in all three repetitions.

dut-inter.notice: Repetition 01 of the detailed log shows the full sequence. The case provides neither GPS coordinates nor inter-node signalling (Xn/NGAP); do not attribute the cause to the network based on this UE log alone.
dut-inter.logLabel: Source: Desafio_S03_Log_DUT_Meridian.html · repetition 01 of scenario 2. The original file is shown unmodified.

cdut-solstice.label: Solstice · inter-frequency
cdut-solstice.title: Inter-frequency handover without RLF
cdut-solstice.description: Solstice · n78 PCI 88 → n41 PCI 145/160 · same network and measurement sequence

evidence.title: Same inter-frequency scenario
evidence.html: The CDUT uses the same site, band pair and measurement sequence (A2 and A5) as the DUT scenario.

evidence.title: A5 report followed by handover
evidence.html: measId=2 is reported between 0.655–0.705 s; RRCReconfigurationComplete between 0.815–0.865 s.

evidence.title: No RLF across repetitions
evidence.html: 3/3 handovers complete; the 0xB959 statistic stays below the OOS threshold.

evidence.title: The difference calls for UE investigation
evidence.html: The contrast lowers the likelihood of a general site failure but does not by itself prove the root cause.

cdut-solstice.notice: The comparison with the CDUT is control evidence, not proof that every RF and network parameter was identical at every instant.
cdut-solstice.logLabel: Source: Desafio_S03_Log_CDUT_Solstice.html · repetition 01 of scenario 3. The original file is shown unmodified.
